The developed comparison proves, for every proper X/k and finite L/k, the index-transport sandwich ind(X_L) | ind(X) and ind(X) | [L:k] ind(X_L); it follows that prime index persists under every prime-to-p extension. Combined with the prime-degree hypersurface dichotomy and N_0(X/k)=ind(X)Z, this yields the explicit degree-one Ax cycle [P_3]-[P_2] and the robust cubic norm obstruction N_0=3Z.
